G11205445.description: Sandy Hill is one of the fourteen Districts of Anguilla. Its population at the 2011 census was 636.

G3573374.description: The Valley is the capital of Anguilla, one of its fourteen districts, and the main town on the island. As of 2011, it had a population of 3,269.

G3573375.description: The Quarter is one of the fourteen Districts of Anguilla. Its population at the 2011 census was 959.

G3573378.description: The Farrington is one of the fourteen districts of Anguilla. Its population at the 2011 census was 624.

G3573380.description: Stoney Ground is one of the fourteen Districts of Anguilla. Its population at the 2011 census was 1,549.

G3573407.description: Sandy Ground is a village and one of the fourteen Districts of Anguilla, and its main port. The long curved beach is backed by high cliffs and a disused salt pond.

G3573418.description: North Side is one of the fourteen districts of Anguilla, a British Overseas Territory in the Caribbean. It covers both coastal and inland areas on the northeastern coast of the main island.

G3573456.description: Island Harbour is one of the fourteen Districts of Anguilla. Its population at the 2011 census was 988.

G3573466.description: George Hill is one of the fourteen Districts of Anguilla. Its population at the 2011 census was 879.

G3573473.description: East End is one of the fourteen Districts of Anguilla. Its population at the 2011 census was 671.

G3573496.description: Blowing Point is a village and one of the fourteen Districts of Anguila, located on the southern coast. It is home to Anguilla's ferry terminal.
